content: वेधस् {%m.%} [विधा असुन् गुणः] .²1 A creator; मदनश्च वेधाः <ls>Māl. 1. 21</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Brahman, the creator; तं वेधा विदधे नूनं महाभूतसमाधिना <ls>R. 1. 29</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 16</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 41</ls>. .²3 A secondary creator (such as Dakṣa, sprung from Brahman); विधाता वेधसामपि <ls>Ku. 2. 14</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²5 Of Viṣṇu. .²6 The sun. .²7 The {%Arka%} plant. .²8 A learned man. .²9 A priest. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of Soma. .²11 A poet. --{%a.%} Performing, accomplishing; गम्भीरवेधा उपगुप्तवित्तः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 16. 10</ls>.
